claim.value: The proposed causal signal is a reduction in missing approval attachments after responsibility becomes explicit, repeated across comparable observation periods if order volume permits.
claim.scope: An anticipated signal specification, not an observed outcome; repetition is conditional on volume.

signal_basis.value: Where attachment responsibility is unclear, assign explicit responsibility prospectively and compare missing-attachment frequency before and after the change across comparable covered orders using the same predefined inspection interval. A subsequent reduction, repeated if volume permits, constitutes the proposed signal; temporal association alone does not exclude alternative causes.
signal_basis.scope: Prospective attachment outcomes under the specified comparison; a causal signal rather than conclusive causal identification.
